**NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) stock performance — through the October 16, 2026 close**

- NVDA closed at **$214.13** on October 16, down **1.43%** that day; its market capitalization was approximately **$5.16 trillion**. [[1]]
- Performance was negative over the latest **five trading days (-5.39%)** and **one month (-2.38%)**, but positive over **three months (+5.58%)**, **year-to-date (+14.82%)**, and **one year (+16.87%)**. [[1]]
- On a comparable close-to-close basis, the stock rose from **$181.81 on October 16, 2025** to **$214.13 on October 16, 2026**, a **17.78%** gain. [[2]]
- The shares reached an all-time closing high of **$239.24 on October 6, 2026**, leaving the October 16 close about **10.5% below** that peak. [[2]]
- Over the preceding 12 months, NVDA’s quoted closing-price range was **$165.17 to $239.24**, illustrating meaningful volatility despite the positive one-year return. [[2]]

**Analyst price targets**

- The broader S&P Global-derived consensus was **“Strong Buy”** from **62 analysts**, with an average 12-month target of **$328.72**, a median target of **$315**, a low target of **$180**, and a high target of **$515**. [[3]]
- Against the $214.13 close, the $328.72 average target implied **53.51% upside**, while the $315 median implied **47.11% upside**; the target range spans **-15.94% to +140.51%**, which signals substantial disagreement over valuation and execution outcomes. [[3]]
- A separate MarketBeat compilation of **55** analysts showed a less bullish but still positive **“Buy”** consensus, a **$321.89** average target, and a **$210–$515** range, implying **50.32%** upside from $214.13. [[4]]
- Consensus targets have increased from **$304.26 three months earlier** and **$222.23 one year earlier** to **$321.89** in the MarketBeat series, although they edged down from **$324.14 one month earlier**. [[4]]

**Bottom line:** NVDA had delivered solid medium- and long-horizon gains through October 16, but recent momentum had weakened and the shares were roughly 10% below their early-October record close. [[1, 2]] Analyst consensus remained decisively constructive, with roughly 50%–54% average implied upside, though the unusually wide $180–$515 target band underscores elevated uncertainty around the outlook embedded in the valuation. [[3, 4]]
